==Usage==
Copy the template code below for the required usage and paste it into the appropriate place in an article, fill the required fields, and remove any that you don't use. If used in the External links section, do not add an video or archive links. DO NOT USE UNNAMED PARAMETERS.

Note on YouTube Shorts, it is best before archiving/formatting a link from a Shorts to change its URL (<code><nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/shorts/xxxxxxxxxx</nowiki></code>) to a regular YouTube URL  (<code><nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xxxxxxxxxx</nowiki></code>).

===References===
<code><nowiki>{{YouTube|video=|text=|channel=|name=|date=|quote=|subdomain=|parameter=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|nolive=}}</nowiki></code>

====Required parameters====
*{{Para|video}} Use the alphanumeric part of the url that comes after "<code>watch?v=</code>" in the url. Please do not include anything other than this.
*{{Para|text}} Title of the video.
*{{Para|channel}} Use the part of the URL that follows <code><nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/</nowiki></code>, for example, either <code>user/channelname</code>, <code>channel/channelname</code>, <code>c/channelname</code>, or <code>@channelname</code>
*{{Para|name}} The display name of the channel.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

====Optional parameters====
*{{Para|date}} Date the YouTube video was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} To include a quote. 
*{{Para|parameter}} To create a link to a YouTube playlist, using <code>|parameter=playlist?list</code>.
*{{Para|subdomain}} For subdomains of <code><nowiki>youtube.com</nowiki></code>, such as <code><nowiki>music.youtube.com</nowiki></code>, the subdomain can be specified, for example, {{Para|subdomain}}<code>music</code>.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp|YouTube}}

===Externals links===
<code><nowiki>{{YouTube|channel=|name=}}</nowiki></code>

====Required parameters====
*{{Para|channel}} Use the alphanumeric part of the URL that follows <code><nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/</nowiki></code>, for example, either <code>user/name</code>, <code>channel/name</code>, or <code>c/name</code>.
*{{Para|name}} The display name of the channel.

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{YouTube|video=f98TW0-_10c|text=Lucky kid Visits the set of The Empire Strikes Back Dagobah set. Meets Mark Hamill|channel=channel/UCWAveNRXoE2mJ2xwWtA4TSw|name=Filmumentaries com|archivedate=20160126062413}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{YouTube|video=f98TW0-_10c|text=Lucky kid Visits the set of The Empire Strikes Back Dagobah set. Meets Mark Hamill|channel=channel/UCWAveNRXoE2mJ2xwWtA4TSw|name=Filmumentaries com|archivedate=20160126062413}}

<hr />
For a playlist:

<code><nowiki>{{YouTube|video=PLiJsK_sFeeKygEepqlUoXIBwcyeGfXrXx|text=The Complete Music of Star Wars: The Old Republic|channel=channel/UCBGBXQmTRZ0uwfxvcCMfz_A|name=swtheoldrepublic|parameter=playlist?list|nobackup=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{YouTube|video=PLiJsK_sFeeKygEepqlUoXIBwcyeGfXrXx|text=The Complete Music of Star Wars: The Old Republic|channel=channel/UCBGBXQmTRZ0uwfxvcCMfz_A|name=swtheoldrepublic|parameter=playlist?list|nobackup=1}}

<hr />
For a channel (External links):

<code><nowiki>{{YouTube|channel=channel/UCBGBXQmTRZ0uwfxvcCMfz_A|name=swtheoldrepublic}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{YouTube|channel=channel/UCBGBXQmTRZ0uwfxvcCMfz_A|name=swtheoldrepublic}}
